title: ÆTHER: Tara (Carnatic EDM anthem, the high-note drop)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_styles: a huge modern festival EDM anthem built on Carnatic classical music: progressive house at 128 BPM with massive supersaw synths, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, deep rolling bass, wide bright modern mix

the melody is Carnatic raga Hamsadhwani in D: D E F# A C# only, no G, no B; phrased like a Carnatic singer with slides, fast gamakam ornaments and quick sangathi variations, every repeat of the hook a little more ornamented
a powerful Carnatic-trained female voice is the star: she sings the hook in swara syllables (sa ri ga pa ni) and soars to long, ringing high notes on the upper-octave D
real Carnatic instruments played by real musicians, close and natural: mridangam, ghatam, kanjira, Carnatic violin, veena; a tanpura drone on D and A underneath
hype and attention every few seconds, euphoric, goosebumps

brief.notes: Jithesh 3 Nov 07:56: the 4 EDM songs were 'bit boring with usual music tone', no hype or high note that grabs attention; wants Carnatic knowledge used in the EDM album process. Carnatic EDM album, track 1. Devices: grab at 0 s with the singer's long high note alone; swara hook; sangathi (each repeat more ornamented, like a Carnatic singer's variations) instead of a plain loop; korvai (phrase x3 landing on beat 1) as every build-to-drop; tara sthayi high note held over each drop; a mridangam/ghatam/kanjira tani duel breakdown; tisram (triplet) switch in the last drop. Composition plan (chunks) so each section is forced. Hamsadhwani D, 128 BPM, 2:30.

story: A packed open-air festival at night. One Carnatic singer steps up, and every time she climbs to the high note, the whole crowd of 50,000 explodes.
